title: Landfall and Escarpment
author: Felix Almeida
blurb: Felix Whitlock, a riverboat captain who knows every sandbar's mood, has spent five years measuring life in miles rather than years. Then an expedition upriver stops answering the radio — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
